response.original_title: Mein Mann, der Kronprinz - Die Thronfolger in Norwegen und Dänemark
response.overview: Who are the crown princes who will ascend the throne in Norway and Denmark in the foreseeable future? In “My Husband, the Crown Prince,” Julia Melchior takes a look at the two heirs to the throne and the role their wives play in their lives.
response.title: Mein Mann, der Kronprinz - Die Thronfolger in Norwegen und Dänemark
